title: FlexiQuiz Review (2026)
intro: FlexiQuiz is evaluated here as HR, workforce & training software — FlexiQuiz is online quiz and assessment software for training, education, and certification — question banks, timed tests, certificates, and reporting. Published plans (2026-08-19): Essentials ~$20/mo, Standard ~$35/mo, Premium ~$55/mo on annual billing. HR training/LMS-adjacent — not a full HRIS or course marketplace like Trainual. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s HR methodology (ease of use, hiring/workforce fit, workflow depth, integrations, mobile/frontline, analytics, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose FlexiQuiz when assessments and quizzes are the training deliverable.
verdict: Choose FlexiQuiz when assessments and quizzes are the training deliverable. Compare Trainual for SOP + onboarding documentation. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, minimums and usage rates on the vendor site before purchase.
